summary: Tested three new features for Fairy Star Vacation Homes: 1) Map view toggle on /stays page with Leaflet/OpenStreetMap, 2) Customer Journey interactive timeline page at /journey, 3) CRM Webhook configuration in admin settings. All features working correctly. 9/9 backend tests passed, all UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Stays page: Grid/List/Map view toggle buttons visible and functional
Map view: Leaflet map renders with dark CartoDB tiles
Map markers: 21 orange pin markers displayed for properties with coordinates
Map popup: Clicking marker shows popup with property image, name, area/city, beds/baths/guests, and price
Map popup navigation: Clicking popup navigates to property detail page (/stays/{id})
View toggle switching: Switching between Grid, List, and Map views works correctly
Customer Journey page: Accessible at /journey with animated hero section
Customer Journey timeline: 6 steps (Explore & Discover, Plan & Inquire, Book & Pay Securely, Arrive & Check In, Enjoy Your Stay, Check Out & Stay Connected)
Customer Journey animations: Framer Motion animations working with scroll reveals
Journey CTA buttons: 'Explore Stays' navigates to /stays, 'Contact Us' navigates to /contact
Navigation: 'JOURNEY' link appears in navbar between SERVICES and CORPORATE
Admin Settings: CRM Webhook section appears with enable toggle, URL input, and test button
CRM webhook API: GET /api/admin/crm/settings returns settings (enabled, webhook_url)
CRM webhook API: PUT /api/admin/crm/settings saves settings correctly
CRM webhook API: Endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Admin Property Form: map_lat and map_lng fields present in Location section
Admin Property Form: Coordinate fields display existing values (e.g., 25.203344, 55.278754)
Property API: Properties list includes map_lat and map_lng fields with valid UAE coordinates
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyMap.jsx: Uses react-leaflet with custom orange SVG markers - well implemented
StaysPage.jsx: View mode state ('grid'|'list'|'map') toggles cleanly with conditional rendering
CustomerJourneyPage.jsx: Good use of Framer Motion with useInView for scroll-based animations
SettingsPage.jsx: CRM Webhook section follows same pattern as email settings - consistent UX
PropertyForm.jsx: map_lat/map_lng fields properly bound with data-testid attributes for testing
Layout.jsx: Navigation links array includes Journey between Services and Corporate - correct ordering
Backend server.py: CRM webhook endpoints (GET/PUT/POST test) properly secured with auth middleware
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 21 properties with migrated coordinates
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features tested and working: 1) Map view on /stays uses react-leaflet with CartoDB dark tiles and orange markers. 21 properties have coordinates populated. Marker popups show property details and navigate on click. 2) /journey page has Framer Motion animated timeline with 6 steps, CTAs link to /stays and /contact. 3) CRM webhook in admin settings has CRUD endpoints at /api/admin/crm/settings and /api/admin/crm/test. PropertyForm has map_lat and map_lng fields in Location section. MOCKED APIs: Email (Resend) disabled, Cloud Storage S3/R2 disabled, CRM Webhook real but requires external URL.
